title: Total tensor of A-module and R-module complexes
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings. For an $A$-module $M$ and an $R$-module $E$, use the $A$-module $M\otimes_A(A\otimes_R E)$, the tensor product of modules [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] of $M$ with the base change $A\otimes_R E$ of $E$ to $A$ [def-weil-module-base-change], canonically $M\otimes_R E$, with $A$ acting through $M$. Applied to cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], this bifunctor gives the total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] $B(M,E)=\operatorname{Tot}(M\otimes_R E)$ in $A$-modules: $B(M,E)^n=\bigoplus_{p+q=n}M^p\otimes_R E^q$ with differential $d_M\otimes1+(-1)^p1\otimes d_E$. It is functorial in both complexes.
